artworks.title: Insanity
artworks.description: Pink, lilac, and peach overlap in this oil painting, with flashes of yellow and blue cutting through. Loose shapes suggest faces and figures without quite settling into them.

artworks.title: Infinite Jester
artworks.description: A red figure stretches across a wide yellow space, its long arms reaching toward the edges. I painted this piece in oil on linen.

artworks.title: Bedouin
artworks.medium: Oil, acrylic, and paper on black plexiglass
artworks.description: I used oil, acrylic, and paper on black plexiglass for this piece. Sweeping white and violet marks cross the dark surface, with bright green appearing around the edges.

artworks.title: Brooklyn Bridge Study
artworks.description: My small acrylic study of the Brooklyn Bridge at night. Dots of yellow light trace the cables against a deep blue sky, above the dark bands of the river.

artworks.title: Blue Tower Study
artworks.description: A blue tower rises behind a tangle of green branches. This is one of my small New York studies in acrylic on paper, with the building and sky sharing much of the same blue.

artworks.title: Waterfront Dusk Study
artworks.description: Bright blue water fills the foreground beneath a pink and gray evening sky. Across the water, small yellow lights pick out the buildings along the shore.

artworks.title: Night Block Study
artworks.description: Orange and yellow lights break through a dark city block beneath a broad gray sky. One of my small New York studies, painted in acrylic on paper.

artworks.title: River Trees Study
artworks.description: A dark tree trunk and its canopy frame an open stretch of river and pale blue sky. A few light strokes interrupt the deep blue water below.

artworks.title: Green Field Study
artworks.description: Short green marks scatter across a yellow-green surface, with traces of blue showing through. A small acrylic study where the individual brushstrokes stay easy to see.

artworks.title: City Street
artworks.description: Fragments of newspaper show through pale layers of paint, alongside faint pink and blue lines. In this mixed-media cityscape, the street almost disappears into the surface.

artworks.title: Candle
artworks.description: A yellow candle sits in a haze of gray and pink, its narrow flame reaching upward. Look closely and you can see ridges, streaks, and small breaks in the painted surface.

artworks.title: Cat and machine
artworks.image: /paintings/imported/Cat and machine_2025_12.5 x 23.5in_oil on wood panel.jpg
artworks.description: A cat with its tail raised faces a dark, boxy machine across a quiet room. I painted the pair in oil on wood panel, using muted pinks, browns, and gray.
artworks.file: imported/Cat and machine_2025_12.5 x 23.5in_oil on wood panel.jpg

artworks.title: Vacuuming
artworks.description: An elongated figure bends over a vacuum cleaner in a pink room. Broad curves run through the body and clothing, giving an everyday chore an unfamiliar shape.

artworks.title: It's getting cold
artworks.description: Deep blues and grays surround a curled figure. The curved brush marks follow the body and spread into the space around it, making the figure partly disappear into the room.

artworks.title: Heaven
artworks.description: A cat looks out from a landscape of orange, blue, and white. Broad bands of color sweep behind it, with a pale branching shape near the center.

artworks.title: Two Trees
artworks.description: Two dark, branching forms emerge from a pale green surface. I painted this piece in gouache on Yupo paper; small streaks and patches of color fill the space around the trees.

artworks.title: Runnin'
artworks.description: A figure twists through green, blue, and orange, with one arm curving up across the painting. This is a small oil on canvas board, just eight by six inches.

artworks.title: Head I
artworks.description: A pale blue-green head nearly blends into its background. A broad band crosses the eyes, while curved brush marks describe the jaw and neck.

artworks.title: Head III (Noodlehead)
artworks.description: Purple strokes loop around a head and spill out toward the edges. A yellow bowl sits below, and a long curved shape hangs above the figure.

artworks.title: Head IV
artworks.description: A green head emerges among loose blue, yellow, and pink marks. A small round object in the foreground brings those colors together beneath the face.

artworks.title: Jacket
artworks.description: A jacket hangs over a chair in a room of ochre, brown, and white. Dark lines pick out its folds, while parts of the room remain loosely brushed in.

artworks.title: Cow
artworks.description: I used blue and white throughout this small oil painting. Broad, curved strokes carry the form into the surrounding shadows, with the canvas texture still visible.

artworks.title: Pain
artworks.description: A seated figure folds forward, turning its face away. Thick strokes of ochre, pink, and dark gray follow the back, shoulders, and bent legs.

artworks.title: Sitting figure
artworks.description: A seated figure rests beside a green plant in a loosely painted interior. Short, thick marks describe the body, with patches of canvas showing between them.

artworks.title: Mask off
artworks.description: A floating face in pink and purple sits against a flat yellow background. Dark eyebrows, hair, and a beard give the head its shape, while yellow shows through the eyes.

artworks.title: Our Deal Leader
artworks.description: A pencil portrait built from overlapping, angular lines. Dense shading surrounds the face and jacket, while much of the paper below stays open.

We each see nature through different eyes
